name: Procedural Grid Game
description: A turn-based tile game on an endless, chunk-generated Perlin-noise world, where enemies chase the player with A* pathfinding and dig through walls when that's the cheaper route.
highlights: Infinite world generated in 32×32 chunks from vectorised Perlin noise
A* over 8 directions where breaking a wall is just a costlier step, so diggers tunnel when it pays off
Actions take turns to complete, scaled by per-entity modifiers like "slow moving" or "fast digging"

media.caption: Recorded from the game: the player (cyan) tunnels east while enemies (red) path-find after it
